notablePrerequisites:
Deadeye Navigator paired with Sky Hussar.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
description:
Activate all mana producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Activate Sky Hussar by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Sky Hussar enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Sky Hussar trigger, untapping all creatures you control.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Sky Hussar.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use Deadeye Navigator's abilities to blink any number of creatures you control any number of times.
